name: Haroon Sheikh
bio: Haroon is the founder of Tiny Comet Studio and leads development across everything we make. He has extensive, hands-on experience building apps end to end — from the first sketch and UI design, through development, to publishing and updating on the App Store and Google Play.

That same full-stack app know-how now goes into our games: polished, friendly products that feel great on a phone and on a PC. [PLACEHOLDER: add a personal line about what got you into making apps and games.]
